2:## Makes the balloon's sprite sheet, assets/sprites/balloon_lowpoly/balloon_lowpoly.png, from the
3:## author's generated image beside it, balloon_lowpoly_gemini.webp, which stays as it is.
4:## (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Assignment 7: the low-poly balloon replacing the pixel-art one.)
5:## The image is 765 x 1024: six cells of 255 x 512, 3 across and 2 down, on a flat green
6:## background with faint dark green lines between the cells. This:
7:##   - keys the green to transparent: how much greener a pixel is than its red and blue sets
8:##     its alpha, so the edges fade instead of keeping a green fringe; and takes the green
9:##     spill out of what's left (green no higher than the brighter of red and blue);
10:##   - lines up the float's three cells (0, 1, 2): the balloon's body is found in each (the
11:##     opaque pixels in the cell's top 48 %), and cells 1 and 2 are shifted, whole pixels
12:##     only, so their body's box starts where cell 0's does; the pop's cells (3 to 5) are left
13:##     where they are;
14:##   - clears a BORDER-pixel frame round every cell, where the lines between the cells cross
15:##     (nothing of the balloon comes that close to a cell's edge: checked when it's run);
16:##   - writes the sheet at the same size, every cell in its place.
17:## Nothing is resampled or repainted: pixels only move within their cell, or lose their green.
18:## Run it from the project folder (it prints what it found and did):
19:##   ../Godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe --headless --path . --script res://tools/make_balloon_sheet.gd
20:## Written by Claude Code on 21 Nov 2026 at the author's request.

# --- Moves ---------------------------------------------------------------------

## Out of the way, everyone calm, then each at step `steps[i]` of their routine (the
## camper, the low-poly man, the girl), staying at it.
func _settle(steps: Array) -> void:
	Input.action_release("sneak")
	_player.place(AWAY)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _states() == "WORK WORK WORK", 40.0)
	var people: Array[CampPerson] = [_camper, _man, _girl]
	for i in people.size():
		if people[i]._step != steps[i]:
			people[i]._step = steps[i]
			people[i]._arrived = false
		people[i]._step_left = 400.0
	await _until(func() -> bool: return people.all(func(p: CampPerson) -> bool: return p.at_activity()), 30.0)
	await _wait(0.5)

## of the balloon sheets, bobbing on its string to `float` (animations/balloon_float.tres) on
## its own AnimationPlayer. This script is that player's one authority, the only caller of
## its play() and seek().
##   - `colour` (red, yellow or blue) picks the sheet and where in the float it starts, so
##     the three at the party don't sway in step.
##   - pop() is the bite's (camp_balloons.gd, game code): it sets `popped` and plays `pop`

func _ready() -> void:
	texture = SHEETS[colour]
	_anim.play("float")
	_anim.seek(FLOAT_OFFSETS[colour], true)

		return
	popped = true
	_anim.animation_finished.connect(_on_finished)
	_anim.play("pop")


func _on_finished(anim_name: StringName) -> void:
	if anim_name == &"pop":

extends SceneTree
## Assignment 7, Step 4: the read-back of the balloon's float (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "The evidence
## split": the float row; "The sheet, for each sprite clip"; "The cycle spec: the balloon's float").
## It loads props/party_balloon.tscn and reads back, against the brief's values:
##   - every track in every clip resolves to a real node and property or bone (the course's check,
##     branching on track type);
##   - the float's track: a value track on the Sprite3D's frame, UPDATE_DISCRETE;
##   - every frame key is a cell the sheet has (below hframes * vframes);
##   - the keys: cells 0, 1, 2, 1 at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 s, within half a frame (1/48 s), never ==;
##   - length 1.0 s, step 1/24 s, LOOP_LINEAR;
##   - the seam for a frame track: the last key's cell differs from the first's, and the gap from
##     the last key to the length equals the key interval;
##   - the Sprite3D: hframes 3, vframes 2, one of the five balloon sheets; the AnimationPlayer:
##     callback_mode_process IDLE, autoplay empty.
## A headless run draws nothing: this reads the clip's structure, not how the float looks.
## Run it from the project folder:
##   bash scripts/run-test.sh test_balloon_float.gd 60
## It prints PASS or FAIL per check and a count, and quits with exit code 1 if any check fails.
## Written by Claude Code on 21 Nov 2026.

const SCENE := "res://props/party_balloon.tscn"
const CLIP := "float"
const FPS := 24.0
const HALF_FRAME := 1.0 / 48.0
const HFRAMES := 3
const VFRAMES := 2
const CELLS: Array[int] = [0, 1, 2, 1]
const TIMES: Array[float] = [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75]
const LENGTH := 1.0
const SHEETS: Array[String] = [
	"res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_red_4.png",
	"res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_yellow.png",
	"res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_green_4.png",
	"res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_purple_2.png",
	"res://assets/sprites/balloons/balloon_blue_4.png",
]

var _passed := 0
var _failed := 0


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run()
	print("%d passed, %d failed" % [_passed, _failed])
	quit(1 if _failed > 0 else 0)


func _check(ok: bool, what: String, detail: String = "") -> void:
	if ok:
		_passed += 1
		print("PASS %s" % what)
	else:
		_failed += 1
		print("FAIL %s%s" % [what, (": " + detail) if detail != "" else ""])


func _near(a: float, b: float) -> bool:
	return absf(a - b) <= HALF_FRAME


func _run() -> void:
	var packed := load(SCENE) as PackedScene
	_check(packed != null, "the scene %s loads" % SCENE)
	if packed == null:
		return
	var balloon := packed.instantiate()
	root.add_child(balloon)

	var sprite := balloon as Sprite3D
	_check(sprite != null and balloon.name == "Balloon", "the scene's root is a Sprite3D named Balloon",
			"%s %s" % [balloon.get_class(), balloon.name])
	var player := balloon.get_node_or_null("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
	_check(player != null, "the Balloon has an AnimationPlayer")
	if sprite == null or player == null:
		return

	# The sheet and the node.
	_check(sprite.hframes == HFRAMES, "hframes is %d" % HFRAMES, str(sprite.hframes))
	_check(sprite.vframes == VFRAMES, "vframes is %d" % VFRAMES, str(sprite.vframes))
	var sheet := sprite.texture.resource_path if sprite.texture != null else ""
	_check(sheet in SHEETS, "the texture is one of the five balloon sheets", sheet)
	_check(player.callback_mode_process == AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_IDLE,
			"callback_mode_process is ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_IDLE", str(player.callback_mode_process))
	_check(player.autoplay == "", "autoplay is empty", "'%s'" % player.autoplay)

	# Every track of every clip resolves.
	var problems := track_problems(player)
	_check(problems.is_empty(), "every track in every clip resolves to a real node and property or bone",
			"; ".join(problems))

	# The float.
	_check(player.has_animation(CLIP), "the clip %s exists" % CLIP, str(player.get_animation_list()))
	if not player.has_animation(CLIP):
		return
	var clip := player.get_animation(CLIP)
	_check(_near(clip.length, LENGTH), "the length is 1.0 s (within 1/48 s)", "%.10f" % clip.length)
	# step exactly, not within half a frame: the default 1/30 s is only 0.008 s from 1/24 s, so
	# a half-frame tolerance would pass a clip left at the default (the author's review, 21 Nov 2026).
	_check(is_equal_approx(clip.step, 1.0 / FPS), "step is 1/24 s", "%.10f" % clip.step)
	_check(clip.loop_mode == Animation.LOOP_LINEAR, "loop_mode is Animation.LOOP_LINEAR", str(clip.loop_mode))
	_check(clip.get_track_count() == 1, "the float has one track", str(clip.get_track_count()))
	if clip.get_track_count() < 1:
		return

	var t := 0
	var is_value := clip.track_get_type(t) == Animation.TYPE_VALUE
	_check(is_value, "track 0 is a value track (TYPE_VALUE)", str(clip.track_get_type(t)))
	var path := clip.track_get_path(t)
	var target := player.get_node(player.root_node).get_node_or_null(NodePath(path.get_concatenated_names()))
	var on_frame := target == sprite and path.get_subname_count() == 1 and path.get_subname(0) == "frame"
	_check(on_frame, "track 0 is on the Sprite3D's frame", str(path))
	if not is_value:
		return
	# value_track_get_update_mode only of a value track (CLAUDE.md, "Headless facts").
	_check(clip.value_track_get_update_mode(t) == Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE,
			"track 0 uses discrete updates (UPDATE_DISCRETE)", str(clip.value_track_get_update_mode(t)))

	var count := clip.track_get_key_count(t)
	var cells: Array = []
	var times: Array = []
	for k in count:
		cells.append(clip.track_get_key_value(t, k))
		times.append(clip.track_get_key_time(t, k))
	print("  keys: cells %s at %s s" % [cells, times])

	var inside := true
	for c in cells:
		if typeof(c) != TYPE_INT or c < 0 or c >= sprite.hframes * sprite.vframes:
			inside = false
	_check(inside, "every frame key is a cell inside the sheet (0 to %d)" % (sprite.hframes * sprite.vframes - 1),
			str(cells))

	_check(count == CELLS.size(), "the float has %d keys" % CELLS.size(), str(count))
	if count != CELLS.size():
		return
	var values_ok := true
	var times_ok := true
	for k in count:

		% Engine.physics_ticks_per_second)

class Probe extends Node:
	var test: Object

	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
		test.call("step")


func step() -> void:
	_tick += 1
	if player == null:
		player = level.get("player")
		camp = level.get("campsite")
		balloons_node = camp.get("balloons")
	var jumping: bool = player.get("jumping")
	if jumping and not _was_jumping:
		_jt = 0
	elif jumping:
		_jt += 1
	elif not jumping:
		_jt = -1
	_was_jumping = jumping
	for b: Sprite3D in balloons_node.get("balloons"):
		var anim := b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
		if b.get("popped") and not _seen_popped.has(b):
			_seen_popped[b] = true
			var heard: Array = []
			for person: Node3D in camp.get("people"):
				var d := Vector2(person.global_position.x - b.global_position.x, person.global_position.z - b.global_position.z).length()
				var at: Vector3 = person.get("_noise_at")
				heard.append([person.name, d, at.distance_to(b.global_position) < 0.01])
			_pops.append({"balloon": b, "tick": _tick, "jt": _jt, "heard": heard, "visible": b.visible,
				"clip": String(anim.current_animation)})
			_after[b] = {"cells": [], "starts": 0, "hidden": -1, "last": INF, "pop_tick": _tick}
		elif _after.has(b):
			var a: Dictionary = _after[b]
			if b.visible:
				if not b.frame in a.cells:
					a.cells.append(b.frame)
				# `pop` began again from its start: its position went back.
				if anim.assigned_animation == "pop" and anim.current_animation_position < a.last - 0.001:
					a.starts += 1
				a.last = anim.current_animation_position
			elif a.hidden < 0:

func _check(what: String, ok: bool, got: Variant = "") -> void:
	_checks += 1

	print("%s  %s  (got %s)" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, str(got)])

	_check("party_balloon.gd: every play() and seek() is on its own AnimationPlayer (%d)" % on_anim, off.is_empty() and on_anim == 3, off)

		var b := real[i]
		var c: String = b.get("colour")
		await _under(b.global_position)
		var before := _pops.size()
		await _jump()
		var mine := _pops.slice(before)
		_check("%s: a jump under it (F held) pops it" % c, mine.size() == 1 and mine[0].balloon == b and b.get("popped") and not b.visible,

## Assignment 7, Step 5 (Step 3 of its plan): Pop the balloons (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Boundaries:
## named changes"; "The cycle spec: the balloon's float" for the balloons; "The phase table:
## the jump" for the bite; "The evidence split": the task row).
##
## In the real level (main.tscn at the developer menu's "free" point, the camp's tasks
## revealed, as tests/jump_pins.gd runs it), with the campers blind to him (campsite.gd
## `cones_on` off, as bear_bag_test.gd and tent_test.gd do) so none of them spots him and
## gives chase, but hearing as ever; driven through the game loop with real key presses
## (Input.parse_input_event), read each physics tick after the bite check. It checks:
##   - the balloons: three, red, yellow and blue, each on its sheet's 3 x 2 grid, 0.3 m across,
##     its middle 0.7 m up, clear of the table's top, with no collision; each AnimationPlayer
##     playing `float` (current_animation) while it's up, not in step with the others;
##   - one authority: in props/party_balloon.gd every play() and seek() is on its own
##     AnimationPlayer; camp_balloons.gd calls neither; no other script uses the balloon;
##   - the task: on the list under Rock the party, with its hint;
##   - three jumps (F held), one under each balloon: each pops it within the bite (ticks 5-14
##     after F is seen); `pop` (animations/balloon_pop.tres) starts on that tick and plays once,
##     through cells 3, 4, 5, and the balloon is hidden once it has played, not on the bite's
##     tick (Step 4); each pop heard by every camper within 8 m of it (HEAR_CHITTER: they
##     turn to it, camp_person.gd `_noise_at`) and by none further; the task not ticked after
##     one or two, ticked on the third;
##   - with balloons the test adds (from the same scene, given to camp_balloons.gd): one at
##     his mouth through the crouch (ticks 0-4) isn't popped, and pops on tick 5; two at his
##     mouth, one jump pops one; one in reach only as he comes down after a running jump
##     (after tick 14) isn't popped.
## A headless run draws nothing: this checks the game's state, not how the balloons or the
## jump look. The source scan can't see an indirect call.
## Run it from the project folder:
##   bash scripts/run-test.sh test_balloon_task.gd 60
## It prints PASS or FAIL per check and quits with exit code 1 if any check fails.
## Written by Claude Code on 21 Nov 2026.

signal ticked

const DevMenu := preload("res://scripts/dev_menu.gd")
const BalloonScene := preload("res://props/party_balloon.tscn")
const CampsiteScript := preload("res://scripts/campsite.gd")
## Well out of the camp, where none of them can see him (scripts/cones_test.gd, _send_away).
const QUIET := Vector3(20.0, 0.02, 6.5)
const HEAR := 8.0
const REACH := 0.25
const COLOURS := ["red", "yellow", "blue"]
## One low-poly sheet for all three, each tinted (CHANGE-BRIEF.md's revision of 21 Nov 2026: it
## replaced the pixel-art sheets): the tints from the camp's matte palette (props/party_balloon.gd).
const SHEET := "res://assets/sprites/balloon_lowpoly/balloon_lowpoly.png"
const TINTS := {"red": Color("b25d57"), "yellow": Color("e2c25a"), "blue": Color("2f5d8a")}
## The body's box in each 255 x 512 px cell (tools/make_balloon_sheet.gd): 163 px across, its
## middle 126.5 px from the cell's left and 143 px from its top.
const BODY_W := 163.0
const BODY_MID := Vector2(126.5, 143.0)
## The table's top, from its middle (campsite.gd _table_legs: 1.28 x 0.83 m).
const TABLE_HALF := Vector2(0.64, 0.415)

var level: Node
var camp: Node
var player: CharacterBody3D
var balloons_node: Node3D

var _tick := 0
var _checks := 0
var _failed := 0
## Ticks since the current jump's press was seen (0 on that tick), -1 when not jumping.
var _jt := -1
var _was_jumping := false
## Every pop: {balloon, tick, jt, heard: [[name, distance, heard]], visible (on the pop's
## tick), clip (current_animation on it)}.
var _pops: Array[Dictionary] = []
var _seen_popped := {}
## For each popped balloon, after its pop tick: {cells: the frames it showed while still
## visible, starts: how often `pop` began (from its start), hidden: the tick it was first
## hidden, last: `pop`'s position last tick}.
var _after := {}


func _initialize() -> void:
	DevMenu._next = "free"
	level = (load("res://main.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate()
	root.add_child(level)
	current_scene = level
	var probe := Probe.new()
	probe.test = self
	# After the player's tick (0) and the bite check's (camp_balloons.gd, 1).
	probe.process_physics_priority = 1000
	root.add_child(probe)
	print("Pop the balloons: the real level at the developer menu's \"free\" point, %d physics ticks a second"
		% Engine.physics_ticks_per_second)
	_run()


class Probe extends Node:
	var test: Object

	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
		test.call("step")


func step() -> void:
	_tick += 1
	if player == null:
		player = level.get("player")
		camp = level.get("campsite")
		balloons_node = camp.get("balloons")
	var jumping: bool = player.get("jumping")
	if jumping and not _was_jumping:
		_jt = 0
	elif jumping:
		_jt += 1
	elif not jumping:
		_jt = -1
	_was_jumping = jumping
	for b: Sprite3D in balloons_node.get("balloons"):
		var anim := b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
		if b.get("popped") and not _seen_popped.has(b):
			_seen_popped[b] = true
			var heard: Array = []
			for person: Node3D in camp.get("people"):
				var d := Vector2(person.global_position.x - b.global_position.x, person.global_position.z - b.global_position.z).length()
				var at: Vector3 = person.get("_noise_at")
				heard.append([person.name, d, at.distance_to(b.global_position) < 0.01])
			_pops.append({"balloon": b, "tick": _tick, "jt": _jt, "heard": heard, "visible": b.visible,
				"clip": String(anim.current_animation)})
			_after[b] = {"cells": [], "starts": 0, "hidden": -1, "last": INF, "pop_tick": _tick}
		elif _after.has(b):
			var a: Dictionary = _after[b]
			if b.visible:
				if not b.frame in a.cells:
					a.cells.append(b.frame)
				# `pop` began again from its start: its position went back.
				if anim.assigned_animation == "pop" and anim.current_animation_position < a.last - 0.001:
					a.starts += 1
				a.last = anim.current_animation_position
			elif a.hidden < 0:
				a.hidden = _tick
	ticked.emit()


func _check(what: String, ok: bool, got: Variant = "") -> void:
	_checks += 1
	if not ok:
		_failed += 1
	print("%s  %s  (got %s)" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, str(got)])


func _key(keycode: int, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = keycode as Key
	ev.physical_keycode = keycode as Key
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)


func _wait(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await ticked


func _until(cond: Callable, most: int) -> bool:
	for i in most:
		if cond.call():
			return true
		await ticked
	return cond.call()


func _real() -> Array[Sprite3D]:
	var out: Array[Sprite3D] = []
	out.assign(balloons_node.get("balloons").slice(0, 3))
	return out


## Holds F until he's down and the landing's over, then lets go.
func _jump() -> void:
	_key(KEY_F, true)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt >= 0, 20)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt < 0, 120)
	_key(KEY_F, false)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return not bool(player.get("model").get("jumping")), 30)
	await _wait(5)


## Puts him on the ground with his mouth (player.gd mouth_point()) under `at`.
func _under(at: Vector3) -> void:
	var off: Vector3 = player.call("mouth_point") - player.global_position
	player.call("place", Vector3(at.x - off.x, 0.02, at.z - off.z))
	await _wait(20)


func _run() -> void:
	await ticked
	camp.set("cones_on", false)
	await _wait(30)
	_structure()
	await _task()
	await _edges()
	print("RESULT: %s (%d checks, %d failed)" % ["FAILED" if _failed > 0 else "all checks passed", _checks, _failed])
	quit(1 if _failed > 0 else 0)


# --- The balloons, the task, one authority -------------------------------------------

func _structure() -> void:
	var real := _real()
	_check("three balloons, red, yellow and blue", real.size() == 3 and real.map(func(b) -> String: return b.get("colour")) == COLOURS,
		real.map(func(b) -> String: return b.get("colour")))
	var table: Array = CampsiteScript.TABLE
	var camp_at: Vector3 = (camp as Node3D).global_position

	for b in real:
		var c: String = b.get("colour")
		var sheet := b.texture.resource_path if b.texture else ""
		_check("%s: its own sheet, sliced 3 x 2" % c, sheet == SHEETS[c] and b.hframes == 3 and b.vframes == 2,
			"%s %d x %d" % [sheet, b.hframes, b.vframes])
		_check("%s: 0.3 m across (its body's 14 px at pixel_size)" % c, absf(b.pixel_size * 14.0 - 0.3) < 0.001, b.pixel_size * 14.0)

## Assignment 7, Step 5 (Step 3 of its plan): Pop the balloons (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Boundaries:
## named changes"; "The cycle spec: the balloon's float" for the balloons; "The phase table:
## the jump" for the bite; "The evidence split": the task row).
##
## In the real level (main.tscn at the developer menu's "free" point, the camp's tasks
## revealed, as tests/jump_pins.gd runs it), with the campers blind to him (campsite.gd
## `cones_on` off, as bear_bag_test.gd and tent_test.gd do) so none of them spots him and
## gives chase, but hearing as ever; driven through the game loop with real key presses
## (Input.parse_input_event), read each physics tick after the bite check. It checks:
##   - the balloons: three, red, yellow and blue, each on its sheet's 3 x 2 grid, 0.3 m across,
##     its middle 0.7 m up, clear of the table's top, with no collision; each AnimationPlayer
##     playing `float` (current_animation) while it's up, not in step with the others;
##   - one authority: in props/party_balloon.gd every play() and seek() is on its own
##     AnimationPlayer; camp_balloons.gd calls neither; no other script uses the balloon;
##   - the task: on the list under Rock the party, with its hint;
##   - three jumps (F held), one under each balloon: each pops it within the bite (ticks 5-14
##     after F is seen); `pop` (animations/balloon_pop.tres) starts on that tick and plays once,
##     through cells 3, 4, 5, and the balloon is hidden once it has played, not on the bite's
##     tick (Step 4); each pop heard by every camper within 8 m of it (HEAR_CHITTER: they
##     turn to it, camp_person.gd `_noise_at`) and by none further; the task not ticked after
##     one or two, ticked on the third;
##   - with balloons the test adds (from the same scene, given to camp_balloons.gd): one at
##     his mouth through the crouch (ticks 0-4) isn't popped, and pops on tick 5; two at his
##     mouth, one jump pops one; one in reach only as he comes down after a running jump
##     (after tick 14) isn't popped.
## A headless run draws nothing: this checks the game's state, not how the balloons or the
## jump look. The source scan can't see an indirect call.
## Run it from the project folder:
##   bash scripts/run-test.sh test_balloon_task.gd 60
## It prints PASS or FAIL per check and quits with exit code 1 if any check fails.

signal ticked

const DevMenu := preload("res://scripts/dev_menu.gd")
const BalloonScene := preload("res://props/party_balloon.tscn")

const QUIET := Vector3(20.0, 0.02, 6.5)

const REACH := 0.25

const SHEET := "res://assets/sprites/balloon_lowpoly/balloon_lowpoly.png"

## middle 126.5 px from the cell's left and 143 px from its top.
const BODY_W := 163.0
const BODY_MID := Vector2(126.5, 143.0)

const TABLE_HALF := Vector2(0.64, 0.415)

func _initialize() -> void:
	DevMenu._next = "free"

class Probe extends Node:
	var test: Object

		test.call("step")


func step() -> void:
	_tick += 1
	if player == null:
		player = level.get("player")
		camp = level.get("campsite")
		balloons_node = camp.get("balloons")
	var jumping: bool = player.get("jumping")
	if jumping and not _was_jumping:
		_jt = 0
	elif jumping:
		_jt += 1
	elif not jumping:
		_jt = -1
	_was_jumping = jumping
	for b: Sprite3D in balloons_node.get("balloons"):
		var anim := b.get_node("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
		if b.get("popped") and not _seen_popped.has(b):
			_seen_popped[b] = true
			var heard: Array = []
			for person: Node3D in camp.get("people"):
				var d := Vector2(person.global_position.x - b.global_position.x, person.global_position.z - b.global_position.z).length()
				var at: Vector3 = person.get("_noise_at")
				heard.append([person.name, d, at.distance_to(b.global_position) < 0.01])
			_pops.append({"balloon": b, "tick": _tick, "jt": _jt, "heard": heard, "visible": b.visible,
				"clip": String(anim.current_animation)})
			_after[b] = {"cells": [], "starts": 0, "hidden": -1, "last": INF, "pop_tick": _tick}
		elif _after.has(b):
			var a: Dictionary = _after[b]
			if b.visible:
				if not b.frame in a.cells:
					a.cells.append(b.frame)
				# `pop` began again from its start: its position went back.
				if anim.assigned_animation == "pop" and anim.current_animation_position < a.last - 0.001:
					a.starts += 1
				a.last = anim.current_animation_position
			elif a.hidden < 0:
				a.hidden = _tick
	ticked.emit()

	print("%s  %s  (got %s)" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, str(got)])

	for i in n:

func _real() -> Array[Sprite3D]:
	var out: Array[Sprite3D] = []

## Holds F until he's down and the landing's over, then lets go.
func _jump() -> void:
	_key(KEY_F, true)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt >= 0, 20)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return _jt < 0, 120)
	_key(KEY_F, false)
	await _until(func() -> bool: return not bool(player.get("model").get("jumping")), 30)

func _under(at: Vector3) -> void:
	var off: Vector3 = player.call("mouth_point") - player.global_position

	await ticked

	await _wait(30)
	_structure()
	await _task()
	await _edges()
	print("RESULT: %s (%d checks, %d failed)" % ["FAILED" if _failed > 0 else "all checks passed", _checks, _failed])
	quit(1 if _failed > 0 else 0)

func step() -> void:

	var jumping: bool = player.get("jumping")
	if jumping and not _was_jumping:

			if b.visible:

## of the balloon sheets, bobbing on its string to `float` (animations/balloon_float.tres) on
## its own AnimationPlayer. This script is that player's one authority, the only caller of
## its play() and seek().
##   - `colour` (red, yellow or blue) picks its tint and where in the float it starts, so
##     the three don't sway in step. All three share one off-white sheet, the low-poly balloon
##     (assets/sprites/balloon_lowpoly/balloon_lowpoly.png, CHANGE-BRIEF.md's revision of 21 Nov
##     2026), tinted with the Sprite3D's modulate.
##   - pop() is the bite's (camp_balloons.gd, game code): it sets `popped` and plays `pop`
##     (animations/balloon_pop.tres, cells 3-5) once, then hides the balloon when it's done.
## The node's offset puts its origin on the balloon's body: the body sits in the 163 x 204 px
## box at (45, 41) of each 255 x 512 px cell (tools/make_balloon_sheet.gd), so its middle,
## (126.5, 143), is 1 px left of the cell's and 113 px above it; the scene draws the cell 1 px
## right and 113 px lower (offset (1, -113); a Sprite3D's +y offset is up). 0.3 m across the
## body: pixel_size 0.3 / 163. The sheet isn't edited.
## Written by Claude Code on 21 Nov 2026.

## Each colour's tint, from the camp's matte palette: the cooler's red (materials/
## cooler_body.tres), the trail mix's yellow band and the bear bag's blue (camp_bear_bag.gd).
const TINTS := {
	"red": Color("b25d57"),
	"yellow": Color("e2c25a"),
	"blue": Color("2f5d8a"),
}
## Seconds into the 1 s float each colour starts at: a third of the way apart, so at any
## moment no two show the same cell for long.
const FLOAT_OFFSETS := {"red": 0.0, "yellow": 1.0 / 3.0, "blue": 2.0 / 3.0}

@export_enum("red", "yellow", "blue") var colour := "red"
## True once he's bitten it.
var popped := false

@onready var _anim: AnimationPlayer = $AnimationPlayer


func _ready() -> void:
	modulate = TINTS[colour]
	_anim.play("float")
	_anim.seek(FLOAT_OFFSETS[colour], true)


## Bitten: it bursts (`pop`, once), then it's gone. Once only.
func pop() -> void:
	if popped:
		return
	popped = true
	_anim.animation_finished.connect(_on_finished)
	_anim.play("pop")


func _on_finished(anim_name: StringName) -> void:
	if anim_name == &"pop":
		hide()
